The first chip is filled cream with a black outline and holds a small solid black square followed by the words "Qwen3-7b-p", and it reads as the chosen chip. Fourth row: one segmented control made of two rectangles joined side by side, the left half reading "Focus" and the right half reading "Grid", the right half filled dark to read as the chosen half. 5. The lower half of the screen: two cream rectangular panels with black outlines, stacked one above the other. Each panel is introduced by a tab strip along its top edge: the upper panel's tab is deep red with the word "TEXT" in white uppercase, and the bold grotesk words "Qwen3-7b-p" sit at the right of that strip; the lower panel's tab is ochre with the word "VIDEO" in white uppercase, and the words "Qwen3-35b" sit at the right of that strip. Under each strip one thin black stroke, then in the empty body of each panel one short centred grey typed line, "Waiting for prompt..." . 6. The screen ends with the lower panel and one thin black stroke. Nothing else is on the screen. A FLAT UI SCREEN DESIGN for a phone, drawn as flat vector shapes, filling the whole canvas edge to edge. The picture IS the screen. No phone body, no bezel, no frame, no mockup, no hand, no desk, no room, no photograph, no 3D, no perspective, no drop shadow, no gradient, no glass, no glow, no bevel, no capsule or pill shaped control, no rounded pill button, no emoji, no watermark. Corners of boxes and chips are square or barely rounded. Design world: a physical card catalogue and a library index translated into a web app. White page ground, cream paper card surfaces (hex F7F4EC), thin black one pixel strokes, near black text, a clean grotesk sans for headings and a monospace typewriter face for all data. Data is set as typed entries: a name at the left, a value at the right, a run of small dots between them, closed by one thin black stroke. Index tabs are plain rectangles filled with the facet colour carrying the facet word in white uppercase. Brass gold (hex C9A227) is used only on the single primary action control. Stamp red (hex B3372E) and stamp blue (hex 2F5D8C) are used only on small status words. Restrained, dense, factual, printed, like a well set library catalogue, not a marketing page. Everything is crisp, correctly spelled and legible at phone scale. No em dash and no en dash anywhere: use plain hyphens, colons, commas and parentheses only. The ONLY words on the screen are the strings given in quotation marks in this brief. Do not letter any other word onto the screen: no annotation, caption, note, legend, key, swatch strip, colour name, descriptive sentence, or explanatory text, and never the words HAIRLINE, REGION, CARD, PANEL, SECTION, BLOCK, EMPTY, INDEX, LEADER, DOTTED or REVERSED anywhere on the screen.
